1. Obtain a valid keybox XML from a trusted source. Keyboxes are not provided; you must find one yourself.
2. Tap "Import keybox" and load the file. Its revocation status is checked with Google right away and again every 24 hours while you visit this screen.
3. Google Play Services, the Play Store and other common targets are added automatically. Open "Manage target apps" to change them.
4. Set target mode to "Leaf" if your device has a working TEE, otherwise leave it as Auto.
5. Recheck your Play Integrity status.

If Google revokes a keybox, it may still allow passing up to device integrity even though strong integrity will fail.
